main.name: Joshua Chai
main.bio: Junior software developer with internship and team project experience in Australia. Worked on web applications using React and Django and developed Python image analysis software for medical research. Seeking a developer role to contribute to projects and learn from experienced developers.

work.title: Software Engineer Intern
work.description:
1. Automated image formatting and file renaming using Python to prepare ophthalmic datasets for processing.
2. Migrated components of an existing image-analysis application from MATLAB to Python.
3. Implemented calculation logic and integrated analysis results into the application's user interface.
4. Debugged processing workflows and updated features based on researcher feedback.
5. Reduced processing time from around 60 seconds to under 30 seconds by optimising processing algorithms.

work.title: Research Assistant, UWA Thesis Project
work.description:
1. Continued developing OCTAVA as part of a master's thesis project, building on previous internship work.
2. Reviewed research needs and existing approaches to define requirements for a new software analysis module.
3. Developed a new analysis module within the existing Python application while maintaining its original functionality.
4. Updated the user interface with adjustable settings and controls for selecting analysis regions and viewing results.
5. Reused existing application components and integrated the new module with result displays and file exports.
6. Compared alternative algorithms using test data and tested the complete workflow from input to export.
7. Delivered the new OCTAVA analysis module and completed the master's thesis and final defence.

work.title: International Student Ambassador
work.description: StudyPerth promotes Perth as a study destination and supports international students. Joined the ambassador program to help fellow students navigate the challenges of studying and living in Australia. Delivered orientation presentations to groups of over 200 students, introducing StudyPerth services and life in Perth. Worked with staff and university teams on student engagement activities and shared student perspectives with education and government representatives.

work.company: The McCusker Centre for Citizenship, Perth, Australia
work.title: Student Advisory Committee Member
work.description: The McCusker Centre for Citizenship connects UWA students with community organisations through internships that promote active citizenship. Joined the committee to give back to the community after learning about active citizenship through the Centre’s program. Shared internship experiences during alumni panel presentations and provided individual guidance to students at Centre events. Contributed to committee discussions on student engagement activities.
